title: Haja Estree
subtitle: The Hidden Path
description: On the surface, Haja Estree was just another unscrupulous hustler on Daiyu, scamming parents with Force-sensitive children. Although Estree posed as a Jedi, there was core altruism in his grift. Haja did care for the safety of the kids, and although he accepted their money, he also transported them to safety.
